high_level_description: A single full-body woman in a floral sundress and straw hat, bending slightly forward, centered on a 1600x900 canvas with pale sky above and grassy ground below.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Pale sky (#e0f7fa) occupying top 780px; grassy ground (#c8e6c9) as 120px-tall horizontal band at bottom.

elements.desc: Straw hat: large beige oval (brim) centered at (800,210) with width 200px, height 60px; smaller beige circle (crown) at (800,210) radius 40px
Torso and head: light pink vertical rounded rectangle (sundress base), 120px wide x 350px tall, slightly shifted right (x=740) to indicate bend
Head: light pink circle, radius 40px, centered at (800,360)
Arms: two thin vertical light pink rectangles, left arm (x=780) and right arm (x=800), each 40px wide x 80px tall, positioned asymmetrically to suggest gentle bend
Legs: two adjacent light pink vertical rectangles, left leg (x=750) and right leg (x=790), each 40px wide x 130px tall, knees slightly bent
Feet: two beige ovals (straw color), each 60px wide x 20px tall, placed side-by-side on grass
Floral motif 1: small blue circle, radius 10px, near torso upper left
Floral motif 2: small red circle, radius 10px, near torso upper right
Floral motif 3: small green circle, radius 10px, mid-torso left
Floral motif 4: small blue circle, radius 10px, mid-torso right
Floral motif 5: small red circle, radius 10px, lower torso left
Floral motif 6: small green circle, radius 10px, lower torso right
